card.name: The start of re- verbs after Do not
card.fires_on: The re- start of words like reconstitute, re-enter, re-sterilize or reinserting. It appears mostly right after "Do not" in preparation instructions.

modes.label: After Do not
modes.description: The re- start of a verb right after a prohibition in vial or syringe handling steps.
modes.example: Do not<< re>>-enter vial. Do not dilute

modes.label: After before or prior to
modes.description: The re- start of a verb after a timing word in reconstitution or lens instructions.
modes.example: Wait 10 minutes after dosing before<< re>>inserting contact lenses.

card.writes: It favors continuations of words that start with re-, such as -entry and entrant, though the tokens are mostly odd.
card.plain: It marks the start of a re- action word, like reconstitute or re-enter, in preparation instructions.
